==Biography==
===League of Legends Career===
On October 21, 2014 it was announced that ackerman had decided to leave LMQ along with Vasilii and NoName, and that negotiations were ongoing with Mor.<ref>http://www.ongamers.com/articles/lmq-announces-departure-of-vasilii-ackerman-noname/1100-2279/</ref> Ackerman renamed to '''GodLike''' and rejoined his old team [[Star Horn Royal Club]].<ref>[http://t.qq.com/p/t/460084052817978 SH皇族電子競技俱樂部隊員公告 (Chinese)] ''t.qq.com''</ref> On May 16, 2015 it was announced that GodLike joined [[Royal Never Give Up]].<ref>[http://www.weibo.com/p/1001603843034738517261 SHR's Weibo Post (Chinese)] ''t.qq.com''</ref> On July 28, 2015, GodLike retired.<ref>[http://p.t.qq.com/longweibo/index.php?lid=18426173070598657488 Godlike's Tencent Weibo Post (Chinese)] ''qq.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''GodLike''' was given to him from a friend because he needed to have a English in game name for the competitive sever and he didn't know English at that time.<ref>[http://www.acfun.tv/v/ac2058838 AcFun弹幕视频网] ''acfun.tv''</ref>
* Became known by the Chinese community for defeating [[PDD]] 3 times individually on {{ci|Renekton}} in a solo queue game. 
* Climbed up to Rank 1 in Chinese solo queue ladder playing almost exclusively {{ci|Renekton}}.
* Also known as "King of {{ci|Renekton}}" in China.
* Used to only play full damage {{ci|Renekton}} before [[PDD]] countered it with 13 armor Quint {{ci|Ryze}}.
* Was invited to join [[Royal Club Tian Ci]] from [[Wh1t3zZ]] after reaching Rank 1.
* Looks up to [[PDD]] and [[GoGoing]] as idols.
* Has huge respect for western Junglers [[Diamondprox]] and [[Meteos]] as he had no idea how to play against them during Season 3.
